import bpy
exec("fol=bpy.data.collections['Reference_Foliage']
def suffix(o):
 s=o.name.rsplit('.',1)[-1];return int(s) if s.isdigit() else 0
def foot(o):
 pts=[o.matrix_world@v.co for v in o.data.vertices];low=min(p.z for p in pts);ps=[p for p in pts if p.z<low+.05];return sum(ps,Vector())/len(ps)
trunks=sorted([o for o in fol.objects if o.name=='Tree_Trunk' or o.name.startswith('Tree_Trunk.')],key=suffix)
crowns=sorted([o for o in fol.objects if o.name.startswith('D19_Tree_Crown')],key=suffix)
branches=sorted([o for o in fol.objects if o.name=='Tree_Branch' or o.name.startswith('Tree_Branch.')],key=suffix)
print('COUNTS',len(trunks),len(crowns),len(branches))
print('TREE_FOOT',[(i,list(foot(trunks[i]))) for i in range(10,len(trunks))])
print('SHRUBS',[(o.name,list(o.matrix_world.translation)) for o in fol.objects if o.name.startswith('L20_')][:3])
